text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, sevoflurane is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 41 units of the 1 mL/mL 250 mL presentation at 9 units per day (4.6 days on hand). Corvale General holds 157 units at 8.5 units per day (18.4 days on hand). Both sites' inventory is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (NDC 72162224502) with manufacturing plant FEI 1000519407.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected the Bryant Ranch Prepack plant (FEI 1000519407) on 2009-06-11 and classified it OAI. The most recent inspection ended 2026-07-16 and was classified VAI.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is critically low. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support a transfer while maintaining adequate coverage. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list, but their labels do not identify a manufacturing plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 37 units of 1 mL/mL 250 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from AbbVie Inc. — requires buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Baxter Healthcare Company — requires buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Halocarbon Life Sciences, LLC — requires buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Lannett Company, Inc. — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
